Security review details **Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The affected attack boundary is external CDN content entering visitors' documentation-page execution context. Permitted scripts retain page-origin authority; access to other same-origin assets depends on deployment privileges that were not supplied. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _inferred_ — A changed cdnjs response with a nonmatching digest is rejected by a browser enforcing subresource integrity, reducing the CDN-tampering path for the five protected assets. The unchanged Tailwind script remains a separate path for remotely supplied code to execute in the page. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _inferred_ — Integrity pins asset bytes rather than sandboxing approved code. Anonymous CORS loading excludes credentials from these cross-origin requests, and no-referrer suppresses referrer disclosure for the five assets. - _observed_ — Earlier source-attributed inspections reported that all five fetched assets matched their declared SHA-512 digests and returned HTTP 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
